decisions.decision: Controlled Speakr fork v0.11.1 at verified commit; no new standalone clinical web product
Reuse Flask/SQLAlchemy; no FastAPI rewrite
Reuse Vue/Tailwind and existing components; compact German UI
PostgreSQL in integration and production; retain isolated upstream SQLite tests
Reuse ProcessingJob/JobQueue; clinical outbox only for durable domain intents
Existing local persistent storage adapter; no new S3 cluster
dss-codec in server worker; never build codec on each workstation
Reuse local Speaches for batch and evaluate its existing transcription-only realtime API; training/lexicon/profile capabilities must be proven separately, never silently removed.
Local Speakr user management is initial runtime default; implement but disable tenant-bound Entra OIDC. Hybrid later; no mandatory Keycloak/LDAP/SMTP for local operation.
Stable existing user.id for domain ownership; explicit issuer+subject identity linking with approved tenant/object mapping; no email linking; account policies enforced.
.NET10 Import-Agent nur für Datei-/Geräteabholung. Sämtliche Diktatbedienung ausschliesslich Browser, kein Windows-Companion.
Edge WebView goal; Mock/Disabled adapters until documented manufacturer contract
Human correction confirmation mandatory for final clinical delivery; optional additional acceptance as PAR-WF-009; explicit working-transfer distinct from final KIS delivery.
Internal foreground recorder; no intentional persistent audio/text; no downloads
Separate author resource pools and staff pools; explicit author scopes, deny exceptions and action grants; own is secure default, not a permanent scope limitation.
Dedicated CLINIC_MODE with default-deny classified endpoints; no mixed personal instance
Immutable accepted originals; configurable safe source deletion implemented and tested; default/pilot off.
Stable copy is not EOL. EOL filter explicit and default on; intentionally disabled filter uses authorized stable-snapshot path with correct provenance.
No patient inference from audio/name/last KIS window/Windows login
Frozen revision per selected delivery target; distinguish working transfer/final output; UNKNOWN disallows uncontrolled retry or opportunistic second send.
No LLM rewrite/chat/summaries/voiceprints/RAG/public share/personal webhooks
Synthetic local password accounts first; OIDC fixture tests isolated from runtime. Missing provider credentials never block local implementation.
Preserve AGPL notices; provide corresponding fork source to users; review dependency/model licenses
CPU smoke; GPU optional and measured; private homelab is not clinic inventory
No routine clarifications or per-slice approval; record bounded defaults and continue
No live data/deploy/destructive/admin action without explicit gated approval
Pinned upstream; separately reviewed upgrades with endpoint regression
Clinic constraints override mutable upstream SystemSettings/env; unexpected policy mismatch fails closed
No public publishing and no VPN scope expansion; trusted ingress channel cannot be client-selected
Mock results are not hardware/browser/manufacturer or clinical certification
Reuse local user management; removal means disable/unassign when domain references exist, no destructive cascade.
Existing Werkzeug scrypt service, widened password column, one-time hashed recovery codes, shared throttling and revocable server sessions.
Linking preserves user.id and domain history; default linked account entra_only; dual login requires explicit audited exception.
Application-owned roles/pools by default for all providers; no automatic Entra claim privilege assignment.
Local identity acceptance independent from later G-ENTRA/G-LDAP. Account lifecycle and CA limits explicit.
Retain complete Grok supplement. New local-first directive overrides only superseded identity choices.
101 source functions are mandatory; no automatic N/A or removal due to engine limitations.
Webclient ist alleiniger Diktatclient; keine nativen Wrapper, Plugins, Erweiterungen oder Hintergrunddienste als Funktionsumgehung.
Source catalog behavior retained; source no-KIS/no-BYOD/new-stack instructions superseded by current user project.
BYOD ohne Persistenz. Optionales genehmigtes Managed-Web-Offlineprofil mit verschlüsselter Browserablage; keine native Aufnahme.
Web-/Clipboard-/Dateiausgabe oder freigegebene serverseitige Integration; keine Fremdfenstersteuerung. Original-Konflikte bleiben im WG-Register.
Manual/static evidence is not runtime parity; original BT clauses retained and real dual-run evidence required.
Originals kept byte-exact outside build; no proprietary code/resources/DB copied into fork.
Real validated acoustic/language adaptation required where catalog demands it; prompt biasing is not profile learning.
No automatic historical DB migration; controlled cutover and existing archive responsibilities retained.
